name: GenerationStatus
description: Current status and results of a Firefly generation job

jobId.description: Unique identifier of the generation job

status.description: Current status of the generation job

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was created

modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was last modified

outputs.description: Generated output images or videos (present on success)

errors.description: Errors encountered during generation (present on failure)
